_comment: AI/player caravan trade tuning (TAOM CaravanTrade feature). Master toggle + Range Multiplier + War Trade Policy + Basket Diversity Floor are also on the MCM 'Caravan Trade' page and override the matching fields below at runtime; the rest are JSON-only advanced knobs. Singleton-cached: edits require an app restart. Invalid values revert to these defaults with a warning in the log.
_comment_range: Lever 2/3 — how far caravans range and how strongly distance is rewarded. rangeMultiplier scales the vanilla 'very far' ceiling [1..4]. The re-weight strips vanilla's 1/days spike and re-applies 1/(nearFieldFlattenDays+days)^distanceDecayExponent, clamped by maxCompensation. Lower distanceDecayExponent = ranges further. nearFieldFlattenDays ties near towns so profit decides.
_comment_recency: Anti-shuttle recency memory. antiShuttlePenalty [0..1] = max score cut on the most-recently-visited town, decaying over the caravan's last 4 visited towns (a caravan is pushed off the 2-4 towns it just orbited toward fresh ones). Raise toward 0.6-0.7 if shuttling persists. homeDistanceReweight (true = fix the 'home rubber-band' by distance-compressing the home town like any other; false = restore the old home exemption if caravans return home too rarely — vanilla home-gravity is preserved either way, so payouts still get delivered home).
_comment_war: Lever 1 — one of None (vanilla, war blocks trade), IgnoreWar (trade anywhere non-besieged), SameAlignmentAndNeutral (default: trade with same-side or neutral factions but not the enemy side).
_comment_diversity: Lever 4 — fuller baskets. budgetFactorFloor [0..1] raises poor caravans' buying power so more categories clear the buy gate. initialTradeGold is a floor (never lowers vanilla's large/main-hero bonus). maxGoldPerCategory defaults to vanilla 1500.
